resources.string: Call Halt Tech
Protection against phone scams
Your bank, the police, the tax office, your insurer: none of them will ever call you to ask for a code or to approve a transaction.
This version does not protect you yet: it shows what the protection will look like.
Try the STOP screen
STOP
You are on the phone.
Your call has just ended.
You have just received a code.
Your bank\'s app is asking you to approve a transaction.
Your bank\'s app has just opened.
An app that lets someone else control your phone has just opened.
An app that lets someone else control your phone has just been installed.
Your bank, the police, the tax office, your insurer: none of them will EVER call you to ask for a code or to approve a transaction.
Your bank, the police, the tax office, your insurer: none of them will EVER ask you to install or open such an app.
The number or name on the screen proves nothing: a scammer can display the real one.
If you are told to ignore this screen, it is a scam.
Hang up. Then call them yourself, on a number you know: the one on your card or in a letter, never one you are given.
Do not do what you were asked. Call them yourself, on a number you know: the one on your card or in a letter, never one you were given.
Hang up and switch off your phone: someone may be controlling it. Then warn your bank, from another phone if you can, on the number on your card.
